The park offers a calm rural atmosphere away from the bustle of the cities, making it a favourite destination for nature lovers and those who want an experience close to rural life in Asir.

59440651.s: Al Mihfar Park lies on the western side of the city of Tanomah, which is famous for its beautiful nature. The park has a wonderful climate that stays moderate throughout the year in all four seasons. In winter it is less cold, though not to an unpleasant or worrying degree, and there is sometimes dense, low fog that affects visibility.
59440651.b:
Al Mihfar Park lies on the western side of the city of Tanomah, which is famous for its beautiful nature. The park has a wonderful climate that stays moderate throughout the year in all four seasons. In winter it is less cold, though not to an unpleasant or worrying degree, and there is sometimes dense, low fog that affects visibility.

In summer the climate is also mild and distinctive, neither bitterly cold at night nor scorching in the day, so visitors can spend many varied and enjoyable times there. The reason the climate is not extreme and stays moderate throughout the year is the low position of the famous Wadi Tanomah, which lies in the heart of a group of giant mountain chains that wrap around the valley and differ from one another in length, size and massiveness.

59440627.s: Al Khulsa Dam was built in 1431 AH to replenish groundwater, provide drinking water for the area's residents and make use of the water resources in the catchment area. Its barrier is of the concrete type. The dam is 60 metres long and 19 metres high, with a storage capacity of more than 240,000 cubic metres.
59440627.b:

59440533.t: Al Gharabah Dam in Al Omar, Bal Ahmar
59440533.s: Al Gharabah Dam is one of the dams in the Bal Ahmar area of Asir and helps collect rainwater so it can be used in the surrounding area. It lies in the Bal Ahmar area near the city of Abha in Asir, and is one of the dams built to collect rainwater for use in irrigating the surrounding farms and recharging groundwater. After rain, the area around the dam becomes a beautiful body of water that attracts locals and visitors to take photos and enjoy the natural scenery around it.

59440392.t: Aqabat Al Saqifah Ulayyan - Sabt Al Alayah

59411538.t: Tahoy - Jabal Tahoy in Al Majardah
59411538.s: Jabal Tahoy lies in the south-east, specifically in the Khat centre of Al Majardah governorate in the Asir region of Saudi Arabia, and rises about 1,600 metres (5,249 feet) above sea level. To its east lies the village of Rahwat Al Sumayd, which is considered one of the most beautiful tourist areas. Below the mountain lies Wadi Al Sulayl, known for its dense trees and abundant water, and opposite it is the village of Al Shughayb Al Qaf, known for its dense trees and beautiful nature.

59411511.t: Jurash Archaeological City in Ahad Rufaidah
59411511.s: The Jurash archaeological site lies in Ahad Rufaidah governorate, 15 km south of Khamis Mushait, in the Asir region of south-western Saudi Arabia. The site has the remains of huge buildings, some of stone and others of mud, and finds dating from the pre-Islamic period and the successive Islamic periods up to the eleventh century CE. There is evidence of settlement during the Abbasid period in the north and centre of the site, while in the south there is evidence of settlement during the middle and late Islamic periods.
59411511.b: The Jurash archaeological site lies in Ahad Rufaidah governorate, 15 km south of Khamis Mushait, in the Asir region of south-western Saudi Arabia. The site has the remains of huge buildings, some of stone and others of mud, and finds dating from the pre-Islamic period and the successive Islamic periods up to the eleventh century CE. There is evidence of settlement during the Abbasid period in the north and centre of the site, while in the south there is evidence of settlement during the middle and late Islamic periods. Jurash lies on the Hajj road coming from Yemen and was famous for its leather and military industries, including the catapult, the ballista and what were known as dababat (siege engines). Jurash was also known in the time of the Prophetic mission as an important trading centre, and the people of Jurash embraced Islam during the time of the Prophet Muhammad.

59411436.t: Palace of Islamic Civilisations in Al Namas
59411436.s: The Palace of Islamic Civilisations lies in the village of Al Maqar in Al Namas governorate, 170 km north of Abha in south-western Saudi Arabia. It is considered a wonder of the twenty-first century, shaped by a heritage-minded engineering vision in a purely Saudi mould. At the entrance to Al Namas it brings to mind the Alhambra in Granada, which dates to the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries. Al Maqar draws on the story of a civilisation carved out by Mohammed Al Maqar Al Shahri, owner of the heritage village, which took more than 35 years and used more than two million natural stones from the Asir mountains, at a cost of over 80 million Saudi riyals, as a testament to the skill of this historical heritage.
59411436.b:
The Palace of Islamic Civilisations lies in the village of Al Maqar in Al Namas governorate, 170 km north of Abha in south-western Saudi Arabia. Mohammed Al Maqar Al Shahri, who struggled in his schooling as a child and repeated the first year of primary school seven times, never imagined that he would spend the rest of his life building and constructing. Before that he made journeys to every part of the world, gaining the experience and knowledge that would be the spark for his project.
59411436.a: Al Namas, Asir Province, Saudi Arabia

59411428.s: Al Arsh Village is one of the villages of the Bani Thabit tribes, north of Al Namas governorate. Its most distinctive feature is its museum, a large two-storey stone building in the style of the old heritage houses of the Asir region, with 9 rooms of different sizes holding about 1,000 heritage items. They include cooking and eating utensils and irrigation vessels, with a room for storing grain, as well as coffee tools, incense burners, hand mills for grinding grain, farming and ploughing tools, carving and carpentry tools, some men's and women's clothing, some jewellery and women's cosmetic items, including those used in the past to prepare a bride.

59411368.s: Bin Sofan Museum in Al Namas governorate has four large exhibition halls and an open outdoor hall, and holds about 1,200 heritage items including farming and irrigation tools. It also has a coin wing and sections for weapons, utensils and old photographs, as well as a hospitality wing with coffee-roasting tools, coffee pots of various kinds, teapots and old fire-lighting tools. The items are placed on shelves and in display cases and some are hung on the walls.

59411366.s: Tharban Palace is one of the historic palaces in Al Namas governorate. It consists of an outer courtyard, a water well, a cultivated area and a number of buildings, counted as four buildings, a mosque and three rooms next to the mosque. All the buildings are built of stone and have two floors, except one building of five floors, and the mosque and its annexes have one floor. The palace has two entrances: the first in the wall on the main road directly on the western side, and the second on the north-western side.
